Corollary
[isometry-group bound under nonpositive Ricci curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0333 ↗ thm:pet-ch8-bochner-negative-ricci 1. ch8:8.2.3With $(M,g)$ as in item 3, \[ \dim (\iso (M,g))=\dim (\mathrm{Iso}(M,g))\le \dim M, \] and $\mathrm{Iso}(M,g)$ is finite if $\mathrm{Ric}(M,g)<0$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch8-isometry-dimension-bound-negative-ricci \sketch By item 3, every Killing field is parallel, so evaluation at one point embeds $\iso (M,g)$ into $T_pM$. The identification in section 1 gives the group-dimension statement. Under strict negativity the Lie algebra vanishes; the compact isometry group of compact $M$ is therefore discrete and hence finite.

□
